description: This file defines the 'Busy' struct and associated methods to manage server busy state, including cluster notifications and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Busy
classes.description: Represents the server's busy state, manages busy status, expiration, and cluster notifications.

methods.name: NewBusy
methods.description: Creates a new Busy instance with optional cluster interface for notifications.

methods.name: IsBusy
methods.description: Returns true if the server is currently marked as busy.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Marks the server as busy for a specified duration and notifies cluster nodes.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Marks the server as not busy and notifies cluster nodes.

methods.name: Expires
methods.description: Returns the time when the server is expected to no longer be busy.

methods.name: ClusterEventChanged
methods.description: Handles cluster event indicating a change in busy state.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the busy state to JSON format.
